messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. recurring symptom = cold KV window + high p95 for tiny inference requests when traffic bursts. we agreed on remediation + tests. want owners nailed down here.
sophia: I can take ownership of the KV instrumentation and make the cold-hit trace visible in the perf dashboard. ETA: 2024-05-02. I'll file RED-2502 and add dashboard tiles.
mina: I'll implement the new regression cases. thinking: one end-to-end with 1-token batches, one with mixed small batches, and one that simulates prefix eviction. will add them to the nightly suite and a targeted PR gate for runtime changes. ETA: 2024-05-06. ticket RED-2503.
jordan: I'll curate the prompt set to surface the model mismatch and bad-cache sequences. also will add automated scoring so regressions are measurable rather than eyeballed. ETA: 2024-05-04. RED-2504.
tim: I'll schedule two chaos drills: a narrow injector to cause KV resharding and a wider burst test that increases short-lived requests. propose dates: 2024-04-30 (injector) and 2024-05-07 (burst). will coordinate ops calendar and on-call. also updating load runner scenarios. ticket RED-2505.
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem brief posted: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2024-04-29-kv-spike (auto)
runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-spike (auto)
mina: sample test snippet I'll add to the repo:```yaml
- test_name: tiny_batch_kv_warmup
  model_variant: rwd-micro-1
  sequence_length: 64
  batch_profile: [1,1,1,4]
  rewrite_prefix: short
  expected_p95: < 120ms
  tags: [postmortem-driven, nightly]
```
sophia: For the dashboard I'll add a "KV cold-hit ratio" and a trace link on p95 alerts. also adding a synthetic that replays the spike pattern every 12h so we can watch regressions over time.
alex: Thanks. A couple process asks: 1) PR template for postmortem-driven tests (owner, why, how to reproduce, perf budget). 2) Labeling convention: postmortem/RED-#### on tests and prompts. I'll draft both and push by EOD.
jordan: on the PR gate scope: agree with targeted gating. PR gates only for runtime/model-rollouts that touch serving code or config. nightly for everything else.
tim: +1. also let's make the chaos drill outputs feed into the regression harness so failures create issues automatically if thresholds exceed.
mina: accepting ownership :thumbsup: I'll open RED-2503 with checklist and link here.
sophia: accepting RED-2502.
jordan: accepting RED-2504.
tim: accepting RED-2505. scheduling inject now.
alex: Action summary (I'll keep this in RED-2501 tracking epic): - RED-2502: Sophia  KV instrumentation + dashboard  ETA 2024-05-02 - RED-2503: Mina  regression tests (3 cases) + PR gate filters  ETA 2024-05-06 - RED-2504: Jordan  prompt set + eval scoring  ETA 2024-05-04 - RED-2505: Tim  chaos drills + load scenarios  dates 2024-04-30 & 2024-05-07
Please react with :thumbsup: if these look right or propose new dates. I'll post the PR template and labeling guidelines once drafted.
